bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant to Comunidades Organizando el Poder y la Acción Latina (COPAL) to equip a new center for community engagement.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$7,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Comunidades Organizando el Poder y la Acción Latina (COPAL), to design, construct, furnish, and equip a new Latino Center for Community Engagement (LCCE). The LCCE must establish working spaces for COPAL and partner organizations and serve as a training center to foster workforce development and employment. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant to Comunidades Organizando el Poder y la Acción Latina (COPAL) to equip a new center for community engagement.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$7,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Comunidades Organizando el Poder y la Acción Latina (COPAL), to design, construct, furnish, and equip a new Latino Center for Community Engagement (LCCE). The LCCE must establish working spaces for COPAL and partner organizations and serve as a training center to foster workforce development and employment. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. This is a onetime appropriation.

The LCCE must establish working spaces for COPAL and partner organizations and serve as a training center to foster workforce development and employment. This appropriation is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. This is a onetime appropriation.
